Raj (Tax): FYI - Neuron Labs (IE) invoice landed in AP with NO VAT number. Invoice# 2026-045, EUR 12,000. Vendor billed Redwood US LLC. AP flagged missing VAT & no W-8/W-9 on file. Do we need to gross-up or apply any withholding? Asking because payment already went out last week. @Maria

Maria (Finance): Thanks Raj. Can you paste the invoice lines here? Quick answers: if they're EU and invoicing a US entity for services, typically VAT shouldn't apply, but we need their VAT reg number to confirm. For US withholding, a W-8 BEN-E is needed to avoid 30% backup withholding. If no W-8, we may be at risk.

Raj (Tax): Invoice snippet: ```Invoice: 2026-045
Amount: EUR 12,000
VAT: (blank)
Payable to: Neuron Labs Ltd
Address: 18-22 Dublin Rd, Dublin, IE```

Sophie (Legal): @Raj + @Maria - If the supplier is EU and supplying services to a US-registered Redwood entity, reverse charge typically does not apply (that's for intra-EU B2B). They should not charge VAT to a US customer; instead they might zero-rate or not include VAT. Ask vendor for VAT registration number anyway — if they reissued with VAT 0% and a note like "supply of services to non-EU customer - VAT not charged" that would be ideal. On withholding: we need a completed W-8 BEN-E before future payments. If none on file, we should treat as no treaty claim and backup withholding rules could apply. :thinking:

Evan (Ops): We wired the payment last Tuesday. If vendor reissues, can AP do a credit and reissue? Also curious about gross-up: do we ever gross-up so vendor receives full net if tax withheld? Contract says vendor bears taxes unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Maria (Finance): Policy recap: we don't gross-up for vendor tax mistakes unless contractually obligated. For VAT billing mistakes, we request a corrected invoice; AP will not pay twice. For U.S. withholding (if it were applicable), we only gross-up when contract requires it. Action items: 1) Raj to request VAT reg number + W-8 BEN-E and ask for corrected invoice with explicit VAT treatment. 2) AP to flag the payment and open recovery/recall with bank. 3) Legal to confirm any customer-side exposure.

TaxBot: Automated reminder - missing W-8 on file may trigger backup withholding. See internal checklist: https://internal.docs/redwood/tax/withholding

Raj (Tax): I will email Neuron Labs now requesting: (1) VAT registration number or corrected invoice with VAT=0% note, (2) completed W-8 BEN-E, and (3) confirmation of remittance details. I copied the payment reference. @Maria can you create the FIN ticket?

Maria (Finance): Done: created FIN-2319 "Neuron Labs - missing VAT / W-8" and assigned to AP + Tax. Tagging AP to pause any similar vendor payments until cleared. :white_check_mark:

Jules (AP): AP update: wire already processed; we'll attempt a recall but success is low. If vendor issues a credit memo + corrected invoice we'll accept and offset. Opening bank recall request now and documenting for audit.

Raj (Tax): Thanks all. I'll post the vendor response here when they reply.
